BudgetArgs.description:
`budget` of a traversal request. Each value may lower the `[traverse]`
cap of the same name, never raise it.

deadline_ms.description: Longest the call may run, in milliseconds.

est_tokens.description: Most estimated tokens the expansions may cost.

SearchMode.description: What `search_code` can do besides the ranked search.

oneOf.description:
Walk the code graph from the symbols the query names instead of
returning a ranked list (needs `[traverse] enabled` on the server).

SteerArgs.description:
`steer` of a traversal request: the rules the ladder applies at each
stop, how many stops there may be, and, on a continuation, the outer
agent's answer to a returned checkpoint.

actions.description:
Only with `handle`: the outer agent's answer to the checkpoint,
`[{"node"?: id, "action": ..}]` with the actions of the rule list plus
`{"budget": {"pops": n, "tokens": n}}` (bounded).

ladder.description:
The rungs, in order, ending with `agent`. Only `rules` and `agent` are
available. A stop no rung can decide returns the checkpoint to the
caller.

likely_complete.description:
Also stop when the walk is estimated to have found this percent of
what it will find (1 to 100). Counts toward `max_stops`; given alone it
starts the ladder like `stop_every` does.

max_stops.description: Most stops in the traversal (never above the `[traverse]` cap).

on_disagreement.description:
Also stop when this many new disagreements have been recorded since
the last stop (a node a fuzzy map offered that a structural map, which
answered the same expansion, did not). At least 1.
Counts toward `max_stops`; given alone it starts the ladder like
`stop_every` does, with the periodic stops at their default spacing.

rules.description:
Rung 1 of the ladder: an array of `{"when": predicate, "then": action}`
rules (at most 64). Predicates: `kind`, `path_glob`, `witness`, `map`,
`score`, `fanout`, `depth`, `budget_left`, `seen_before`, `all`, `any`,
`not`. Actions: `prune`, `expand`, `continue`, `stop`, `{"boost": f}`,
`{"map_on": id}`, `{"map_off": id}`, `{"map_weight": {"id", "weight"}}`,
`{"rerank": "witness"|"depth"|"fanout"}`, `{"redirect": [node ids]}`,
`{"emit": note}`. They can only shrink, reorder or redirect the walk.

script.description: Reserved for an embedded script handler; not available yet.

stop_every.description:
A stop every this many pops. Without it, stops happen every
`pops / (max_stops + 1)` pops while rules are given.

tau.description: Confidence a rung needs to decide a stop, 0 to 1.

budget.description:
With `mode = traverse`: lowers the server's pop, depth, token and time
caps for this call.

handle.description:
With `mode = traverse`: continue the traversal whose `handle` and
`checkpoint` an earlier call returned (the query is then ignored).

mode.description:
`traverse`: walk the code graph (callers, callees, references) from the
symbols `query` names, under `budget` and `steer`, instead of ranking
chunks. `top_k` then limits the reached nodes returned.

steer.description:
With `mode = traverse`: the rules applied at each stop and the stop
settings; with `handle`, also the answer to a returned checkpoint.

top_k.description:
Number of results, 1 through 40; defaults to configured top-k (8). A
search returns at most `rerank_candidate_count` results (24 unless
configured), whatever top_k says; a larger top_k you pass adds a note
to the response.
